response.description:
Claude Opus 4.5 is now available in public preview on
Microsoft Foundry, bringing advanced coding, agentic workflows, and enterprise
productivity to Azure customers. Claude Opus 4.5 sets a new benchmark for performance
and versatility, outperforming previous Claude models and delivering frontier
intelligence at a more accessible price point. With seamless integration into
Foundry Models, Playground, and Agent Service, organizations can build and
scale AI solutions securely and efficiently. The model benefits from Azure’s
enterprise-grade security and compliance, and supports use cases from software
development to financial analysis and cybersecurity. Pricing starts at $5 per
million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens, available in East US2
and Sweden Central regions. Get started today in the Foundry portal. Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Claude Opus 4.5 Available in Microsoft Foundry
